message.content:
I don’t have real‑time market data built into this environment, so I can’t give you the exact price of Bitcoin right now.  

If you’d like the most up‑to‑date price, you can check one of the following:

| Source | How to get the price |
|--------|----------------------|
| **CoinMarketCap** | Visit <https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/bitcoin/> |
| **CoinGecko** | Visit <https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/bitcoin> |
| **Crypto exchanges** (e.g., Binance, Coinbase, Kraken) | Look at the BTC/USD or BTC/USDT trading pair on the exchange’s website or app |
| **Financial news sites** (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters) | Search “Bitcoin price” |
| **APIs** | Use an API such as CoinGecko’s free endpoint: `https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin&vs_currencies=usd` |

If you need help parsing the data from one of those sources or integrating it into a script, let me know!
message.reasoning: User asks for current Bitcoin price. We need to fetch data. There's no function for external API. We can approximate? But we should not fabricate. We can say we don't have real-time data. Provide guidance.
